Attendance.fact: The ordinary minimum attendance is 75 percent in each course.

Examinations.fact: Examination entry closes 30 minutes after the published start time.

Internal Assessment.fact: The internal assessment minimum is 16 marks out of 40.

Condonation.fact: Medical condonation may be considered from 70 percent to below 75 percent attendance, subject to recorded department approval.

Fees.fact: Complete refund applications are processed within 15 working days.

Hostel.fact: Ordinary hostel visitors must leave by 20:00; overnight stays require separate written approval.

Library.fact: Undergraduate students may borrow 4 books for 14 calendar days, with at most 1 renewals when no reservation is pending.

Discipline.fact: A disciplinary appeal must be filed within 5 working days after the written decision is received.

IT and Laboratory.fact: A temporary laboratory account expires after 14 calendar days unless the project supervisor renews access in writing.

Miscellaneous Academic Policies.fact: A complete credit-transfer application should receive a decision within 10 working days after equivalence review begins.
